name: bash
arguments:
{"command":"cd /workspace && python - <<'PY'
import ast
from src.component import calculate_black_area_doubled
module = ast.parse(open('tests.py').read())
passed = failed = 0
for node in ast.walk(module):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Assert):
        call = node.test.left
        args = tuple(ast.literal_eval(arg) for arg in call.args)
        expected = ast.literal_eval(node.test.comparators[0])
        actual = calculate_black_area_doubled(*args)
        if actual == expected:
            passed += 1
        else:
            failed += 1
            print(f'FAIL {args}: expected={expected}, actual={actual}')
print(f'Supplied cases: {passed} passed, {failed} failed.')
PY"}

result.stdout:

Supplied cases: 27 passed, 1 failed.
